Adapt to my gear FAQ Common Questions About the Danelectro FAB Metal What does the Danelectro FAB Metal sound like? The budget metal distortion from Danelectro's FAB line: level, tone and gain only, in a plastic case. Loads of upper mids and treble, squealing harmonics and long sustain — a lot of saturation for very little money. The signal-chain placement on each tone breakdown shows exactly where it sits relative to the rest of the rig. What are the Danelectro FAB Metal's key tonal traits? The Danelectro FAB Metal is characterized by bright EQ, high-gain gain.
